description: Defines the HpackDecoderAdapter class, which wraps http2::HpackDecoder to decode HPACK blocks into HTTP/2 headers, including methods for handling header frames, settings, and errors.

classes.name: HpackDecoderAdapter
classes.description: A wrapper around http2::HpackDecoder to decode HPACK blocks into HTTP/2 headers, with methods for configuration, decoding, and error handling.

methods.name: ApplyHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Applies a new header table size setting to the decoder.

methods.name: GetCurrentHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Returns the current header table size setting.

methods.name: HandleControlFrameHeadersStart
methods.description: Starts handling headers for a control frame, with optional header handler.

methods.name: HandleControlFrameHeadersData
methods.description: Processes a fragment of HPACK header data.

methods.name: HandleControlFrameHeadersComplete
methods.description: Finalizes header processing after all fragments are received.

methods.name: decoded_block
methods.description: Returns the most recently decoded header block.

methods.name: set_max_decode_buffer_size_bytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum buffer size for decoding.

methods.name: set_max_header_block_bytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of an acceptable header block.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the current decoding error status.
